chains.name: Araz
chains.description_en: Araz Supermarket is a supermarket chain in Azerbaijan (Araz also operates SPAR Azerbaijan, per spar-international.com).
chains.notes: PL page https://www.arazmarket.az/az/pages/yalniz-arazda names the six brands (25 food and non-food categories, 1,000+ varieties) but lists no specific products or sizes. Product data taken from Next.js payload of arazmarket.az category pages; is_araz_brand=true seen only for Tac and Soba items. Prices are site shelf prices.

chains.name: Bravo
chains.description_en: Bravo Supermarket runs Hiper, Super, Market and Ekspres store formats across Azerbaijan, many open 24/7.
chains.notes: Products come from Wolt venue Bravo Supermarket Globus Centre; official site has no product catalogue.

chains.name: Tamstore
chains.description_en: Tamstore serves as a chain of mini, city and supermarket-type markets (official site wording).
chains.notes: Products come from Wolt venue Tamstore Supermarket Khatai. Brand Tamli (eggs) probably own label but not confirmed, so not flagged.

chains.name: Rahat Market
chains.description_en: Rahat supermarket network started trading in the Azerbaijani market in May 2009 under the RAHAT trade mark and is a subsidiary of ANC Group.
chains.notes: No product data available (official site shows promo banners only; no Wolt venue URL verified).

chains.name: SPAR Azerbaijan
chains.description_en: Azerbaijan was the second country in the Caucasus region to join the global SPAR network; local retailer Araz operates convenience stores and neighbourhood supermarkets.
chains.notes: Products come from Wolt venue araz-spar-1-3mkr (SPAR 3rd Microdistrict Superstore). Venue also sells Araz-PL-named brands (Tac, Soba, Bloom) but PL status for the SPAR chain is not confirmed on a page, so not flagged.

coverage.araz: arazmarket.az category pages reachable via raw HTML (WebFetch summariser saw nothing; curl showed embedded Next.js JSON, 741 products over ~100 categories). PL page lists brand names only.
coverage.bravo: Official site: store list only. Wolt Globus Centre venue category pages parsed from embedded page JSON (up to 50 items per category).
coverage.tamstore: Official site: corporate info only. Wolt Khatai venue category pages parsed (up to 50 items per category).
coverage.rahat: Home and promo pages reachable but contain no product names/sizes; zero products recorded.
coverage.spar: spar-international.com has no products. Wolt araz-spar-1-3mkr venue parsed (up to 50 items/category). Venue is Araz-operated SPAR.
coverage.mergeNotes: Danone 100 g yogurts at SPAR carry a 'Kz' suffix (e.g. 'Danone Yogurt 100qr Ciyelek Kz'); merged with Tamstore Danone 100 qr on brand+flavour+size, origin not verified. Cross-chain merges (Ankara, Coca-Cola, Lays, Kit Kat etc.) on brand+variant+size. Activia Qaragile = bilberry/blueberry; seed spelling Qara Gilə differs. Wolt prices converted from qepik to AZN. Produce sizes are per kg only. Per-source 'listedAs' keeps the exact chain-specific listing name.
